_doc: STAGING. The Floor is steppers and gogo merged. Go-go alone yielded two boards, because its proper nouns — Chuck Brown, Rare Essence, Backyard, Junkyard — are exactly what a 3-6 letter no-repeated-letter filter deletes, and the bench had already capped it at 12 rather than let it be padded. Folded into Chicago steppin' it keeps its language without having to carry a pack. Two cities, live drums, and nobody sitting down.

theme.name: The Floor
theme.blurb: Chicago steppin' and DC go-go — two cities that never stopped dancing to a live band.

clues.laced: The shoes, tight, because a loose heel ruins a turn
clues.lance: How the good ones cut across a crowded floor without touching anybody

clues.ponies: What the horn section calls the young ones on their first paying set
clues.spin: What a DJ does, and this is not that, and the distinction is defended

clues.pines: The stage boards, and you can feel the kick drum through them
clues.noise: What the neighbors call it, and the permit conversation follows
clues.peon: Who carries the congas in, and it is always the newest member

boards.scene: The frame, and what it is for

clues.handle: How you hold it, and holding it wrong is the difference between two dancers
clues.hand: Open, at her shoulder height, and it waits rather than pulls
clues.lead: Given, not taken, and any teacher will say that in the first ten minutes
clues.land: Where the count puts you, and being early is worse than being late
clues.held: The frame, through the whole eight, even when the feet are doing everything

boards.scene: The glide, and why it looks like nothing

clues.line: What the couple travels along, and crossing someone else's is bad manners
clues.idle: What the hands look like, and are not, for the entire dance

clues.dine: What nobody does beforehand, because the floor fills at ten

clues.absent: What the space between the beats is not, and hearing that is the whole thing
clues.beat: The pocket. Congas, roto toms and cowbell, and it does not stop between songs
clues.set: Runs an hour without a gap, because stopping lets the crowd cool
clues.bent: What the note is, on the horn, right before the crowd answers it
clues.beans: What the band eats after, at three, from the one place still open
clues.bean: What the drummer calls the newest conga player, and it sticks for years
